findings.detail: A 3.0 config whose company_raw root omits privacy_class LOADS with implicit privacy=public (policy_2x loader default, policy_2x.py:151; the 3.0 gate reads the already-defaulted spec attribute). The required-gate only fires on explicit null/empty; external-root omission is rejected via the kind rule. No implicit permission EXPANSION occurs (public is the only legal company_raw value), so the mandatory evidence 'no implicit permission expansion' holds; but the card criterion '缺失即失败' and the receipt claim 'privacy_class 必填（无默认值）' are slightly overstated. Recommend an explicit-presence check on the raw YAML to fully match the criterion.
findings.title: privacy_class required-no-default not literal for company_raw
